title: Iron Triangle runtime configuration
description: Private runtime configuration for the Iron Triangle bridge, schema version 2. Real endpoints, token paths, and bindings never belong in public repositories; this file is the versioned contract for the private config only.

schema_version.description: Config contract version. Version 1 (implicit) used flat launch_agent_* keys; `iron_triangle_bridge.py upgrade` migrates it in place with a backup.

language.description: The run's unified response_language, resolved as explicit launch override > this key > dominant task script > en. Executor and reviewer inherit it jointly. Catalog-backed languages (en, zh-CN) localize static narration; other codes keep English machine fields while models reply in the requested language. Machine protocol fields and the NEEDS_ARBITER / ROUND_CLOSURE_PASS markers stay identical in every language.

idle_wake_seconds.description: Optional dual-idle heartbeat: wake the reviewer when both roles sit idle longer than this many seconds. Absent or null disables the heartbeat.

path.description: Explicit service-definition file path (launchd plist path on macOS).
